latestVersion.changelog:
- Renamed skill to harbor-openclaw to reflect OpenClaw plugin integration.
- Clarified cloud sync behavior: plugin now creates a cloud account on first load for credential setup page support, but no data is synced until harbor remember is called.
- Added mention of zero-knowledge credentials: credentials are encrypted client-side; Harbor Cloud cannot decrypt API keys.
- Improved documentation for plugin users and data privacy guarantees.
